core_obligations: H3: Complete Serre adjoint-trace bounds and sharp simple-group/component extrema, with the original highest-short-root and Weyl-normalizer consequences. Given standard root/Weyl character theory, structural decompositions and algebraic elimination tools, the author constructs canonical invariant derivations from a quadratic differential operator and their character-coordinate matrix, detects critical values including singular compact-group strata through rank/corner and real-form restrictions, and determines the exceptional-group extrema. A second author proof uses symmetry breaking; outer components require a separate fixed-subgroup/trace-shift reduction, followed by the general disconnected compact-group devissage. These are one complete trace-extremum framework, not separate counts per Lie type, representation, matrix helper or alternate proof. The uniform negative-normalised-character theorem18.2 is already2370H3 and is reused, not counted anew. Author Magma calculations/outputs are retained as published, not independently rerun or certified.
proof_roadmap: Canonical invariant derivations/character-coordinate matrix; compact critical strata and exceptional computations; alternate symmetry breaking; outer-component shifts; general disconnected compact devissage and normalizer consequences.
